name: Kaito
concept: A single centered disciplined cyberpunk courier, one person only, protecting a quiet district in a rain-soaked megacity.
body_type: athletic adult with consistent limb proportions
face: angular anime face with a defined jaw and straight nose, softened natural anime facial planes
hair: short black hair with one narrow cobalt-blue front streak
outfit: simple matte charcoal courier jacket with restrained cobalt-blue edge piping, fitted black cargo trousers with minimal pockets, and plain black combat boots
props: one compact messenger bag resting on character-right hip, with its strap crossing from character-left shoulder
additional_notes: One subject only, one body, one head, centered in frame; no collage, no duplicate, no second figure. Keep exactly one #0047AB cobalt streak on character-left (viewer-right in front views). Keep the messenger bag on character-right hip (viewer-left in front views) and never mirror asymmetric details. Target a restrained animation-ready design: 70 percent clean natural anime production finish and 30 percent simplified modern cyberpunk energy.
